component.name: Badge
component.description: A non-interactive status pill communicating run/step state or metadata inline on a card or in the run detail sidebar.

commonPatterns.name: status-badge
commonPatterns.description: Show a card or sub-task's live status. Exactly one per card.

commonPatterns.name: metadata-badge
commonPatterns.description: Additive, non-status metadata alongside a status badge.

antiPatterns.scenario: Using Badge as a clickable filter or toggle
antiPatterns.reason: badges have no interactive states and are not focusable
antiPatterns.alternative: Use Button or Select for anything the user acts on

antiPatterns.scenario: Showing more than one status (running/approval/user/done) badge on one card
antiPatterns.reason: these variants are mutually exclusive per card

accessibility.role: none (plain span; the label text itself is the accessible signal)
accessibility.screenReader: status must never be color-only; label text carries the meaning

aiHints.context: Use variant="running"|"approval"|"user"|"done" for the one live status; "outline"/"gate"/"warn"/"model" for additive metadata.
